decisions.reason: Badge milestone thresholds and on-chain badge placement do not change the mint-number-based referral code identity or its display locations.
The source changes when and where badges are awarded, not which approved badge designs belong to the catalog.
The existing rule that all earned badges transfer with the NFT remains valid unchanged despite the new award thresholds and on-chain destination.
Achievement badge thresholds and placement do not alter the Big Block prize, ticket, funding, or draw rules.
The badge award changes do not alter the amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or destination of referral commissions.
Achievement badge thresholds and placement do not alter the Small Block prize, ticket, funding, or draw rules.
The badge award changes do not modify any primary-sale revenue allocation.
The badge award changes do not affect secondary-sale royalties, their allocation, or ticket-generation behavior.
Awarding badges on-chain does not change the selected Base blockchain network.
Badge milestone and destination rules do not change the $15 primary mint price.
The badge award changes do not alter the NFT ebook product type or unlimited supply model.
Achievement badge awards are independent of prize-winner announcements and the one-click prize claim flow.
